author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** Everything captured as "Out of Scope" in `.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` and as open questions in `design.md` §10. Grouping into a single roadmap epic since these items don't share a coherent milestone shape — they're independent expansions.

**Children (8).**
1. Define Polaris-owned NSIDs (foundation for federation).
2. Add live federation of mod conversations across labeler instances.
3. Add mobile / on-call surface.
4. Add ML classifier integration via gRPC.
5. Add Ozone-to-Polaris migration tooling.
6. Add richer cross-labeler trust model.
7. Add TPM-sealed signing key SigningKey impl.
8. Add hardware-token (PKCS#11 / FIDO2) SigningKey impl.

**Each child requires a design pass before implementation.** Each carries a scope sketch + v1 connection points so the work is tractable when picked up, but the deliverables list will be refined in a per-item design doc (use the `/design` skill to produce them).

**Block chain.** M5 is blocked by M4 (#6) — v1 must reach beta before v2 work starts. Within M5, only the federation pair has an internal block: live federation depends on Polaris-owned NSIDs landing first.

**Done when.** All eight children are designed, implemented, and closed. v2 is a release milestone, not a single shipping unit — children may ship independently as point releases.
